schema.extension_name: string, the extension including the leading dot
schema.extension_subdomain: string, finer-grained area within the domain
schema.format_class: string, 'text' or 'binary' at the byte level
schema.mime_type_source: string, 'known' = documented/registered media type for this format, 'inferred_from_type' = generic fallback derived from extension_type, not authoritative
schema.typical_software: string, applications that read/write the format
schema.platforms: string, operating systems / environments where it is used
schema.is_ambiguous: boolean, true if this extension is used by more than one unrelated format
schema.alternate_meaning_count: integer, number of other records sharing this extension

metadata.coverage_note: No complete registry of every file extension ever created exists; extensions are unregistered, application-invented, and constantly added. This dataset is a broad, curated, domain-partitioned catalogue of well-attested extensions, not a proof of completeness.
